 Cara Delevingne opted for a brown ensemble to attend the 2026 L’Oréal Paris Women of Worth Celebration held at The Ebell of Los Angeles on Wednesday. The supermodel went for a monochrome look, matching a deep chocolate brown Balmain dress with sleek Paris Texas pumps .
 Cara Delevingne at 2026 L’Oréal Paris Women of Worth Celebration held at The Ebell of Los Angeles on Wednesday. 
 She wore the Paris Texas Lidia Slingback 105 heels in the brand’s ebony shade. The pumps are made from dark brown patent calfskin and showcase the brand’s signature Lidia heel — a high, ultra-slender stiletto heel with a sharp, architectural silhouette. It features a towering 105-mm drop, which is approximately 4.1 inches, that creates a dramatic, high-arch pitch.

 The heels have an ultrafine, pin-thin stiletto stem that tapers sharply toward the base, and the top of the heel blends into a clean, geometric block attachment where it connects to the sole, dropping down in a straight, vertical line at the rear.
 Paris Texas Lidia mules. 
 The shoes also feature a sharp pointed toe and an elastic strap that fits snugly around the ankle. They are finished with a leather insole featuring the Paris Texas logo and a lacquered leather sole in a matching color. The slingbacks are available in black, dark cherry, pink rose, taupe and white, and retail for $795. The broader Lidia collection features mules, sandals, boots and pumps.
 The ebony shade matched perfectly with the brown fabric of her Balmain look. The long-sleeved maxi dress featured a high ruched, gathered slit at the side. The design was crafted with a plunging back, strong and structured rounded shoulders and a draped standing collar. There’s also a rectangular gold-tone metal tassel buckle chain that is engraved with “Balmain.”
 Cara Delevingne at 2026 L’Oréal Paris Women of Worth Celebration held at The Ebell of Los Angeles on Wednesday in Los Angeles. 
 Gilbert Flores 
 The 21st annual L’Oréal Paris Women of Worth Celebration honored nonprofit leaders with $25,000 grants, mentorship and a national platform. Eva Longoria , Kristen Bell, Andie MacDowell, Ariana Greenblatt, Aja Naomi King and Coco Jones were among the celebrity guests at the event.
